description: A React functional component that manages game controls for a Tic Tac Toe game, allowing players to switch modes and reset the game.

methods.name: GameControls
methods.description: Renders the GameControls component, providing buttons to switch between Player vs Player and Player vs AI modes and displaying the current game status.

methods.name: getStatusMessage
methods.description: A helper function that returns a message indicating the current game's status, such as displaying the winning player or indicating a draw.
